prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art sprite atlas for a 64x64 Daggerfall Unity portrait animation
Primary request: One clean exact 2-column by 2-row atlas of the same woman's original upper portrait half, rendered as pixel art, with a subtle but clear happy eye expression. Row-major cells: open / half-closed blink / fully closed blink / repeat the identical open pose. Each cell must match the reference crop's exact 64:35 aspect ratio, so the full sheet must be exactly 128:70 ratio. Four equal rectangular cells touch edge-to-edge with no gutters.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact 2x2 repeated upper-half source grid. Match its original identity, pixel scale, framing, olive irises, natural eye spacing, subdued colors, hair/background and upper crop. It is a reference, not a target to copy neutrally.
Style/medium: crisp late-1990s RPG portrait pixel art at nearest-neighbor integer pixel clusters, no smoothing or anti-aliasing.
Lighting/mood: subtly warm, relaxed, kindly happy eye corners, not a broad caricature.
Color palette: fixed muted olive-green irises, dark brown eyelids/brows, subdued tan-brown skin; soft low contrast. No blue pixels, no orange or red drift, no bright white flashes, no hard black brows.
Constraints: Keep both irises the same native pixel width, shape, horizontal placement, gaze, and spacing in all four cells. The eyelid closes vertically over the same fixed eyeball; half-closed and closed poses must not shrink, shift, or remove the iris by moving the eyeball. Stationary brows and creases remain consistent across blink phases. Add only the small eye/brow shape changes needed for warm happiness, clearly distinct from neutral. Preserve original pixel lattice and complete equal cells.
Avoid: wrong sheet aspect, unequal cells, gutters, separators, border, text, labels, extra padding, full face, changed crop or head geometry, nose/mouth additions, different faces across cells, oversized pupils, pupil jumps, eye widening, bright sclera, pink/orange/blue/black color artifacts, painterly texture, blur, smoothing, watermark.
